titles.engine_and_build:
Confirmed. All md5s were re-hashed at 04:3x EDT, unchanged (.claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-adversarial/static/md5sums.txt):
- GLQUAKE.EXE 435,712 B md5 bcf40493, the same file as VOODOO\GLQUAKE.EXE.
- WINQUAKE.EXE 553,472 B md5 0b62b82d: the SciTech MGL build (1996), with MGL DirectDraw, VBE/AF and VESA strings.
- QUAKE.EXE 409,600 B md5 e3e7fcc9: the DOS build, with CWSDPMI.EXE beside it.
- VOODOO\OPENGL32.DLL 142,848 B md5 332ee07b: the Quake II 3.20 3dfx MiniGL (imports glide2x.dll!_grSstWinOpen@28).
No DOS Glide build of Quake and no Quake 1 source port is on the share: not found by a case-insensitive find over Files, depth 5 (darkplaces, quakespasm, fitzquake, proquake, joequake, ezquake, fteqw, tyrquake, markv, vkquake, ironwail), nor in the zip listings of quakepack.zip, glquake-0.97.zip or Quake_106_Full.zip. DOSFILL\QUAKEPRP.ZIP holds a software DOS QUAKE.EXE of 396,288 B (the zip listing, and DIRLIST D:\GAMES\QUAKEPRP on .243 at 04:43).
Launchers (library):
- Play Quake.bat: GLQuake, min_os win2k.
- Play Quake - Software.bat: WinQuake, min_os win2k.
- Play Quake - Voodoo.bat: needs the glide capability. On a VEN_121A&DEV_0009 box it CALLs Play Quake.bat.
- Play Quake - DOS.bat: max_os win9x.

- .124: 1280x960x32, MEASURED at 03:58 (DISPLAYCFG in game, .claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-adversarial/static/124-window-run2-copy.txt) and seen again in the V5 sweep at 04:27-04:29.
- .243 Voodoo: 640x480x16, a launcher constant.
  - The MiniGL picks 512x384 when w<=512 and h<=384; 640x480 when w<=640 and h<=480 (cmp 0x280 at 0x1000b9aa, cmp 0x1e0 at 0x1000b9b2); otherwise 800x600.
- .243 DOS: 320x200 (VGA mode 13h). With no config.cfg in the E: tree, DOS Quake starts at its default mode 0.
- WinQuake: the engine picks its own mode.
The launcher comment '1280x960 measured on .145' is stale for the LCD boxes.
titles.refresh_control:
Confirmed: there is none in any Quake binary or in the MiniGL.
- A case-insensitive ASCII and UTF-16 sweep (refresh, freq, hz, vsync, displayfr, monitor, rate) of GLQUAKE, WINQUAKE, QUAKE, the MiniGL, QLAUNCH and QUAKEUDP finds only r_norefresh, timerefresh, QueryPerformanceFrequency, DDERR_NOVSYNCHW and noise (.claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-adversarial/static/strings-sweep-ci.txt).
- GLQuake: my own audit of all six CDS sites (static/cds-GLQUAKE.txt):
  - 0x4144d0, VID_SetFullDIBMode: gdevmode at 0x8093d8, dmFields [0x809400]=0x1c0000, dmSize 0x9c, and nothing written at +0x78.
  - 0x41514b: the AppActivate re-set, using the same gdevmode.
  - 0x414fc2 and 0x4151a2: CDS(NULL,0).
  - 0x415899 and 0x415a55: CDS_TEST probes.
  - -current ([0x8094a0]) skips the CDS.
- MiniGL: the refresh argument is 0 (GR_REFRESH_60Hz) at 0x100034c5, 0x1000b9f6 and 0x1000ba81.
- .243, Glide 2.56 (disassembled in the kit DLL itself at 0x10018abe-0x10018d62, not only the OSS source):
  - SSTV2_SCREENREFRESH and SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480 accept only 75, 85 or 120 (cmp 0x4b/0x55/0x78). Anything else becomes 60.
  - The 640x480 timings are 60 Hz/31.5 kHz, 75/37.6, 85/43.3 and 120/61.2.
  - CORRECTION: the Win32 DLL looks in the process env, then HKLM Software\3Dfx Interactive\Voodoo2\Glide, then ...\Voodoo2, and nowhere else.
  - sst1InitVoodooFile searches for voodoo2.var only in its __DOS32__ and Mac branches (parse.c). The retail DLL has no voodoo2.var, VOODOO2_FILE or VOODOO2_PATH string.
  - So there is no '.ini' step, and C:\WINDOWS\VOODOO2.VAR never reaches a Win32 Glide game.
- .124:
  - fxBestRefresh (fxapi.c:406) asks for the highest EnumDisplaySettings rate at WxH, unless FX_GLIDE_REFRESH_RATE, SSTV2_REFRESH_RATE or MESA_FX_REFRESH is set.
  - h5 hwcInitVideo (minihwc.c:4675) replaces that rate with FX_GLIDE_REFRESH only if hwcGetenv (line 9547) finds one: getenv first, then HKCU, then the HKLM regPath.
  - getRegPath's 3dfxvs\Device0 branch is at minihwc.c:1404.

titles.fix:
1. XP LCD boxes (.123, .145, .240): GLQuake needs three things that do not exist yet.
   - Phase-1 FLEETRES, for FR_HZ43. It is built as FLEETRES.phase1.exe (df610a98) but not staged.
   - A BUILT, hardened refreshkeep. The 'hardened REFRESHKEEP.EXE' does not exist as a binary. .claude/worktrees/refresh-mech/agent/tools/refreshkeep.exe is md5 d71e09f4, byte-identical to the old agent/tools/refreshkeep.exe (no 3-per-60 s budget and no unknown-rate guard). Only the source in that worktree is hardened. Build it, run tests/native/test_refreshkeep.c, then stage it.
   - A hidden start: either stage hidden.vbs next to it, or better, build refreshkeep with -mwindows so it has no console at all. A console that takes focus makes GLQuake's AppActivate leave fullscreen.
   - Launcher gate: FR_HZ43 GTR 60 and FR_UE1DEV not GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice, on XP only. The survey's 'FR_HZ43 not 0' would also start it on Win7 .195, where FR_HZ43 is 60, for no gain on a box with a display-TDR history.
   - Command: refreshkeep %FR_HZ43% GLQUAKE.EXE 14400.
   - If the 1080p workflow changes the size GLQuake asks for, the rate must follow: FR_HZW for FR_W/FR_H, and nothing for -current.
2. .124: NOTHING TO CHANGE now.
   - The registry override was removed at 04:17 by the session deploying 3dfxctl, so Glide already takes the ICD's 85.
   - Drop the launcher 'set FX_GLIDE_REFRESH' step: it would now override whatever 3dfxctl's refresh setting says, and that is the V5 lane's decision.
   - Tell the V5 lane about the dormant 75 in the vcr-kmd device key.
   - Never run refreshkeep there.
3. .243 Voodoo: only with an operator-declared ceiling.
   - Record it as a per-box HKLM\Software\RetroAgent value, following the ResCapW/ResCapH pattern.
   - One writer then emits an unquoted COMMAND.COM fragment, 'set SSTV2_REFRESH_640x480=75|85|120', which Play Quake - Voodoo.bat CALLs. No declared ceiling means no fragment, and 60 stays.
   - STRIKE the survey's 'phase-1 no-EDID rule would allow 75 if Glide's own timing table counts as the list'.
     - gr_target_hz's no-EDID branch requires the display driver to list the persisted rate at the target size (gr_has_rate). .243 lists 640x480@0, so it returns 0.
     - The Voodoo 2's timing table describes the card, not the monitor.
   - A game-local VOODOO2.VAR is no alternative: Win32 Glide never reads it.
   - The Voodoo2\Glide registry route is a 3dfx driver setting and needs the operator.
4. .243 DOS and .195: nothing to do.
5. WinQuake: leave it.
6. Per-title alternative, unchanged: rebuild GLQuake from id's GPL source with a -freq switch. Protocol 15 matches the DarkPlaces quake1-server (sv_protocolname QUAKE).
titles.fix_risk:
- refreshkeep adds one re-sync about 1 s after each of GLQuake's mode sets.
  - It also fires after every alt-tab return, because AppActivate re-sets gdevmode with no rate.
  - The initial re-apply plus two alt-tab returns inside 60 s use up the 3-re-apply budget. The next drift stops it for the session (visible in refreshkeep.log).
  - It applies with flags 0, so a crash leaves the desktop at 800x600@75 until the next mode set.
  - Unmeasured on Catalyst 8.970/8.593 and ForceWare 340.52; measured only on ForceWare 71.89 (.143).
- refreshkeep checks only that the driver lists the rate at the CURRENT mode. It does not check the EDID or the intended size.
  - With an EDID-capped FR_HZ43 (75, against a vmax of 76) it cannot exceed the panel.
  - Do not reuse it with 'max', or on a no-EDID CRT, without also passing the intended WxH.
- LCDs: 75 Hz at 800x600 on the analog P2312H/E2414H and the DVI E2313H is only what the EDID and driver list. If the scaler frame-drops to 60, it judders.
- .124: no risk from this review, since it proposes no change there.
- .243:
  - An unwatched CRT driven out of range needs a person to recover it.
  - COMMAND.COM upper-cases the variable name. That is harmless: Glide's MSVC getenv compares case-insensitively.
  - Unverified: that START hands the DOS box's environment to a Win32 child.
  - 'Out of environment space' drops the set silently.
titles.verify_on_hw:
Test fullscreen, at the menu, one box at a time, and only after the 1080p workflow releases the LCD screens. Space CRT switches at least 5 s apart.
- XP and Win7: DISPLAYCFG get while GLQuake runs (the method behind the 08-31 60 Hz readings), plus the monitor OSD. On .145, cross-check with WINLIST.
- .124:
  - DISPLAYCFG get during play. The V5 lane's lan_sweep launches every shortcut, so read-only reads can ride along, as the sibling watcher did (Quake III at 1280x960@85, 04:40).
  - The 'vcrctl log' mode lines show the whole sequence: the no-rate 60 first, then Glide's rate.
- .243 Voodoo:
  - Set SSTV2_INITDEBUG_FILE=C:\V2INIT.TXT. On its own that enables the log (print.c:57; the Win32 DLL carries the string).
  - DOWNLOAD the file, never EXEC, and read 'sst1InitVideo() Setting up video for resolution (640, 480), Refresh:NN Hz'.
  - Check the OSD.
- .243 DOS: OSD only.
titles.verifier_notes:
Adversarial re-check, 04:25-05:11 EDT, read-only: GAMERES, DISPLAYCFG get, REGREAD, DIRLIST, and DOWNLOAD on XP only. Evidence: .claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-adversarial/ (static/, boxes/, tools/).
CONFIRMED:
- every md5;
- no refresh knob in any Quake binary (a fresh case-insensitive ASCII and UTF-16 sweep, plus my own CDS audit);
- the MiniGL's ref 0;
- Glide 2.56's 75/85/120-only override, disassembled in the kit DLL;
- the resolutions and best rates, against fresh GAMERES reads;
- no port on the share (case-insensitive search).
REFUTED OR CORRECTED:
(1) '.124 most likely 75, unmeasured': it was measured at 03:58 (124-window run), and it is now stale. FX_GLIDE_REFRESH was deleted at 04:17:07, so .124 is most likely at 85, and the survey's .124 launcher fix is moot.
(2) '.123/.240 unmeasured': both were measured at 60 on 2026-08-31 (perbox, compat DB), .123 on today's driver.
(3) 'the hardened REFRESHKEEP.EXE': it has not been built.
(4) Glide 2.56 on Win32 has no voodoo2.var/.ini step.
(5) The '.243 timing table as the list' option exceeds the no-EDID rule.
(6) .243's 1024x768@75 desktop is a registry value, not a measurement.
(7) The refreshkeep gate needs 'GTR 60' to keep it off .195.
SIDE DATA for the mechanism lane: on 08-31, .143 (ForceWare 71.89, desktop 1024x768x32@100) behaved differently by request.
- GLQuake, whose DEVMODE names W, H and BPP equal to the desktop's, KEPT 100.
- Quake II and SiN (no BPP in dmFields) and glh2 (16 bpp) fell to 60.
- So 'raising the desktop rate reaches knob-less engines' (gameres.h NOTE ON REFRESH, CLAUDE.md) holds only for a request that exactly equals the desktop mode. It never helps the 1080p LCD boxes, where every one of these titles changes resolution.
OBSERVED BUT NOT TOUCHED: the V5 lane's sweep was cycling .124's shortcuts during this review. My only reads there were GAMERES, DISPLAYCFG, REGREAD, DIRLIST and one download of the Glide and ICD DLLs at 04:39. I launched nothing and changed no mode.

titles.title: Quake2Complete
titles.engine_and_build:
Confirmed (re-hashed):
- quake2.exe 362,496 B md5 57dd2cf4. No ChangeDisplaySettings import or string; its 0x400000 immediates are not DEVMODE stores.
- ref_gl.dll 234,496 B md5 b6d33427.
- ref_soft.dll md5 203dc879.
- 3dfxgl.dll md5 332ee07b.
- pvrgl.dll 227,328 B md5 9c28b9a9.
baseq2\autoexec.cfg sets vid_ref gl, gl_driver opengl32 and gl_mode 6, then exec's fleetres.cfg.
- Its comment 'autoexec runs BEFORE VID_Init' is wrong. id's FS_ExecAutoexec is called from CL_Init after VID_Init, and .243's qconsole.log shows 'Loading ref_gl' before 'execing autoexec.cfg'.
The staged rogue\ and xatrix\ directories also carry a config.cfg.
titles.on_boxes:
Confirmed on .123, .124, .145, .195 and .240. Not on .243 (min_os win2k).
Four cmd.exe launchers. Each runs FLEETRES with no cap, writes <mod>\fleetres.cfg (gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE%, vid_fullscreen 1) and starts quake2.exe +set gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% [+set game X].
- Vendor ICD on .123, .145, .195 and .240 (the compat DB has it verified; .145 on ForceWare 340.52).
- .124: retroicd.dll over C:\Games\Quake2Complete\glide3x.dll.
  - NEW: that game-local copy (1,025,320 B, 09-28 02:09) is byte-identical to the system32 copy. Both are md5 38a891e8 (downloaded 04:39), so its being game-local changes nothing for refresh.
  - The tree also holds the V5 lane's game-local retrogl.dll and V56KBENCH.BAT.
titles.resolution_per_box:
gl_mode 8 = 1280x960 on all five boxes: confirmed (GAMERES q2mode 8 at 04:35; FR_Q2MODE=8 in the real fleetres.cmd files).
- MEASURED on 2026-08-31 at 1280x960x32 on .123, .240 and .246/.195 (perbox, DISPLAYCFG).
- .124 MEASURED at 1280x960x32 at 03:55.
Two mode sets per launch, confirmed two ways:
- The source order: the early +set gl_mode 8 lands before VID_Init; then autoexec's gl_mode 6 and fleetres.cfg's 8 mark gl_mode modified, which triggers a vid_restart.
- .124's flight recorder: Glide 'mode 199 @75', restore 'mode 163 1280x1024@85', ref_gl's no-rate CDS 'mode 159 1280x960x32@60', Glide 'mode 199 @75'.
titles.refresh_control:
None; confirmed by my own audit of all five ref_gl CDS sites (.claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-adversarial/static/cds-Quake2Complete_ref_gl.dll.txt):
- 0x1000df07: the DEVMODE at esp+0x1c is memset to 0x27 dwords; dmSize 0x9c; dmFields 0x180000, or 0x1c0000 with gl_bitdepth; nothing written at +0x78.
- 0x1000dfe1: the dual-monitor retry at width*2 (0x180000 or 0x1c0000).
- 0x1000e00b, 0x1000e0a1 and 0x1000e1bb: CDS(0,0).
The strings hold only gl_mode, gl_bitdepth, gl_swapinterval, gl_ext_swapinterval, r_norefresh, vid_ref and SST_GAMMA/SSTV2_GAMMA.
ref_soft uses DirectDraw with no rate.
.124: fxBestRefresh, then FX_GLIDE_REFRESH only if one is set.

titles.fix:
1. XP LCD boxes: a hidden, BUILT, hardened refreshkeep running 'refreshkeep %FR_HZQ2% quake2.exe 14400' in all four launchers.
   - The hardened binary does not exist yet; see Quake1.
   - Gate: FR_HZQ2 GTR 60 and not GlideDrv, on XP only.
   - FR_HZQ2 is phase-1's gr_target_hz at the gl_mode index size.
   - Expect two re-applies per launch, one per mode set, which fits inside the 3-per-60 s budget.
2. .124: nothing to change now; same reasoning as Quake1.
3. Per-title alternative: rebuild ref_gl.dll from id's GPL 3.21 source with a gl_displayrefresh cvar, passed as '+set gl_displayrefresh %FR_HZQ2%'.
   - API_VERSION is 3, the same as 3.20.
   - NEW requirement: unlike SoF's, its GLimp_SetMode must retry WITHOUT the rate before the 3.20 fallbacks. Those fallbacks are a dual-monitor CDS at width*2 and then WINDOWED mode.
4. Do NOT put a rate in fleetres.cfg or the idtech2 body (confirmed):
   - Quake II has no cvar to read it.
   - The body is shared by 7 files across 3 titles.
   - fleetres.cfg is exec'd after the first mode set anyway.
5. No Quake II port is on the share (not found; case-insensitive, depth 5).
6. .195: nothing to do.
titles.fix_risk:

YES: ref_gl.dll's cvar gl_displayrefresh. Independently confirmed (.claude/evidence-refresh/idtech12-adversarial/static/cds-SoldierOfFortune_ref_gl.dll.txt):
- Registration: Cvar_Get('gl_displayrefresh', '0', 1) at 0x3001045c-0x3001046a; the pointer [0x3008cadc] is stored at 0x3001047e.
- The only read is at 0x3001b81f.
- In the DEVMODE (size 0x94, at esp+0x20), when the value is not 0.0:
  - dmDisplayFrequency (+0x78) is written at 0x3001b85d;
  - dmFields becomes 0x580000 at 0x3001b864;
  - CDS is called at 0x3001b8ff.
- NEW, the failure path:
  - '...calling CDS assuming dual monitors:' at WIDTH*2 with no rate (0x3001b9ac/0x3001b9b4);
  - then '...setting windowed mode': CDS(0,0), fullscreen=0, and a windowed retry.

The per-title knob, placed correctly on the command line: start "" SoF.exe +set gl_mode %FR_Q2MODE% +set gl_displayrefresh %FR_HZQ2%
- ADD: FR_HZQ2 must be a rate the driver lists at SoF's ACTUAL depth. gl_bitdepth 0 means the desktop's 32 bpp, and phase 1's list merges 16- and 32-bpp modes.
- Passing '+set gl_displayrefresh 0' when FR_HZQ2 is 0 is correct: it clears an archived value.

- .124: DROP the FX_GLIDE_REFRESH part. It has been moot since 04:17, would override 3dfxctl, and Glide already takes the ICD's 85, which equals FR_HZQ2 (measured 85 at 05:10).

Other risks:
- CVAR_ARCHIVE: direct SoF.exe starts (LANCHECK.BAT) reuse the archived rate. After a monitor swap they could hit the same windowed fallback.
